usb_a.data_pin_treatment: Trim D+ and D- pins; remaining ends may contact only a dedicated insulating PCB area.
usb_a.data_pin_landing_requirement: Rear copper and all vias excluded beneath trimmed data tails. Front-only SMD copper may lie across the 1.6 mm insulating carrier.
photo_observations: Solder-end view shows four electrical tails and two shell mounting legs, one on each narrow side.
Shell legs appear bent outward; their final solder landing positions are not established by shell width alone.
No VBUS or GND markings visible.
usb_a.polarity_reference: Owner-confirmed solder-end photo view: left outer electrical contact is +5V; right outer electrical contact is GND.
usb_a.contact_row_placement: Electrical contact row centred in both axes of the 12 x 4.5 mm shell end face.
usb_a.assembly_adjustment: Electrical connector pins will be straightened during soldering.
usb_a.shell_mounting_land_requirement: Provide generous exposed solder lands outside both narrow shell sides for manually fitted shell legs; do not require precision tab holes or exact tab dimensions. Maintain isolation from VBUS and other non-shell nets.
usb_a.dimensional_policy: Use supplied shell and contact dimensions; accommodate mounting-leg variation with solder land area. No further precise tab measurements requested.
